text_to_speech: The world of Nuanor is mystical and vast. Adventures and new friendships await you. Prepare for every challenge. Prepare to be fast. Ride your mounts to every corner of the land in the blink of an eye. Your hero’s wings are impressive— and let you fight in the air. Yet only with mounts you can take your friends where ever you go… Or several friends… Or... an entire guild. How a champion travels says a lot about you. Which Warden’s path you follow, what monsters you slay. How much treasure you loot and what you achieve in battles against other heroes. There are dozens of unique wing sets and mounts in Revelation Online. Choose ones that suit your tastes — and your ambitions. The world of Nuanor is ever-changing. Prepare to be fast. Never. Ever. Fall behind.

Explore the vibrant world of Nuanor using the power of flight to glide through the air and mounts to journey across the lively, open world!
